spec_quote: All DFFs should be triggered by the positive edge of clk.
fix: Maintain DFF state across rows and update q only on a detected positive clk edge using the sampled d/reset; do not produce q combinationally each row.

spec_quote: Create 8 D flip-flops with active high synchronous reset setting the output to zero.
fix: At the positive clk edge, if reset is high set q to 0; otherwise load d. Do not zero q immediately when reset changes outside a clock edge.
